### Borea v0.6.3

A patch release that helps when the game folder is not the KSA folder. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Game folder

- Borea now says when the game folder holds no KSA.dll, so it is not the KSA folder.
- When KSA is in a subfolder of the folder you chose, Borea offers that subfolder.
- Borea does not start the game from a folder without KSA.dll, in the App and with `borea launch`.
- When StarMap stops with "Could not find KSA.dll", Borea now says what went wrong and links to the Game tab of Settings.
- Borea now finds a native Linux install of KSA by itself.

#### Good to know

- In Simplified Chinese, the new texts show in English until they are translated.

Full changelog: [v0.6.2...v0.6.3](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.2...v0.6.3)
